lead: Sisir Adhikari is an Indian politician, born on 19 September 1941.
As of 2026, he is 84 years old, and his birth date places him under the Virgo sign.
He has held the office of Member of the 9th West Bengal Legislative Assembly and Member of the 13th West Bengal Legislative Assembly.

sections.heading: Sisir Adhikari — Career and Professional Work
paras: His professional record lists politician as his main occupation.

He has held the following offices: Member of the 9th West Bengal Legislative Assembly, Member of the 13th West Bengal Legislative Assembly, Member of the 14th West Bengal Legislative Assembly, Member of the 15th Lok Sabha (2009–2014), Member of the 16th Lok Sabha (2014–2019) and Member of the 17th Lok Sabha (2019–present). He is affiliated with All India Trinamool Congress.
